items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: McCoy Tyner — I engaged him in a lot of gigs that I had because at that time he was 18 years old in Philadelphia.

ctx.x: Yes. Well I appreciate your thoughts on him. Did you ever get to really meet him? Have a conversation with him?

No. The most amazing thing is that every time I was there he has never really come to the bar. Never. The only time I met him was he was outside, and McCoy Tyner — I engaged him in a lot of gigs that I had because at that time he was 18 years old in Philadelphia. But he was taking Trane home and the trunk was open, Trane was there, and I happened to be there. And that’s the only time I said hello. Never saw him other than that. And there are a lot of time in tapes that I do really have that I would expect him to…
Were you surprised at his passing?
